component.name: Signifiage
component.summary: Signage, stage playback and queue console
Tabela, sahne oynatımı ve sıra konsolu

description.p: Signifiage designs signage and stage scenes, plays playlists of text, image, video and capture sources on selected monitors, and keeps a called name queue fed from spreadsheets or in-app entry.
It also runs as a standalone player on a signage PC and exposes a LAN web remote for phones and tablets.

ul.li: Independent program, preview and teleprompter outputs
Queue import from .xlsx, .xls and .ods with live additive sync
Soundboard, timers, schedules and deck control for presentation apps
Camera, X11 window and portal screen capture
